method: Source-dated timeline of YouTube and Google's own announcements and corporate filings; distinguish statement date from known future effective date, cohorts and money units.
population: Platform contracts and program cohorts, not surveyed individual creators

events.title: Google completes acquisition
events.description: SEC-filed Google press release reports the transaction closed, a corporate change rather than creator monetization.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: Select community creators enter revenue sharing
events.description: YouTube adds several prolific original creators to revenue-sharing and promotion opportunities; it is not open admission.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: US and Canada Partner Program applications
events.description: A previously selective pilot expands to accept applications from eligible US/Canada creators subject to audience and content checks.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: Brazil and Spain Partner Program
events.description: YouTube reports expansion to Brazil and Spain, reaching ten countries; an event-specific statement rather than timeless availability.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: YouTube Live initial rollout
events.description: Platform begins integrated live streaming and discovery rollout, not universal livestream access.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: Paid channels pilot
events.description: Selected partners start a paid-channel subscription pilot with offers from USD 0.99 monthly, not today's membership pricing.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: YouTube Red launches in US
events.description: US ad-free membership introduces a subscription-based additional earning route alongside ads.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: Ten-thousand lifetime-view YPP gate
events.description: YouTube introduces a 10,000 lifetime channel-view safeguard for monetization and subsequent review; this is not the current threshold.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: 1,000 subscribers / 4,000 watch hours announced
events.description: YouTube announces revised YPP entry requirements and a February 20 policy transition; this is a historical program cohort.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: Shorts ad revenue share announced
events.description: YouTube announces forthcoming early-2023 Shorts Feed pooled-ad revenue sharing and a 45% creator share of allocated revenue.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: Earlier fan-funding access announced
events.description: YouTube expands qualified creator access to fan funding and Shopping at 500 subs with publication and watch/view gates, not to automatic ads revenue.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: Shopping affiliates at 500 subscribers
events.description: YouTube expands eligible Shopping affiliate access to YPP creators meeting a 500-subscriber minimum and other conditions.
events.limitations: Documented historical event only. Program, product, geography, account review and time period must be checked independently; no earnings distribution inferred.

events.title: February 2027 YPP terms announced
events.description: YouTube announces higher ads/Premium entry thresholds for new applicants effective February 1, 2027; existing creators and fan-funding routes have different treatment.
events.limitations: Announced effective date is in the future as of 2026-10-25. New applicant conditions are not current, and no subscriber requirement not stated in the cited announcement is inferred.

limitations: Historic announcements and pilot products do not imply general availability or current pricing.
Publication date is not assumed to be an effective date without explicit evidence.
Paid channel pilot price is not a creator wage or subscription net payout.
Neither Google corporate value nor platform product milestones determine individual creator income.
